name: Gasthof Wiesenhof
beschreibung:
Sunnily and quietly located on the edge of Scheffau, Gasthof Wiesenhof welcomes guests with friendly family care and comfortable rooms. It is a relaxing retreat in the Kaiser mountains.

The Scheffau cable car station, Lake Hintersteiner See, and walking footpaths are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Wiesenhof in Scheffau provides restful holidays and mountain panoramas near the Wilder Kaiser.
